title: Loans
description: Loans you owe, tracked by hand — pick an account to have its balance follow when you receive the loan and pay each instalment, or don't record in an account for a loan that predates the app
closeConfirmBody: The instalment history stays. The loan can no longer be changed.
emptyBody: Add your first loan to track its outstanding principal.
accountHelper: Which account did the loan money arrive in? Its balance updates to match, from the start date.
paymentPrincipalNote: Principal = Total − Interest, calculated for you.
paymentDeleteConfirmLinked: Both transactions recorded in the account (principal and interest) are removed too and the account balance updates. The principal outstanding is recalculated and "Next due" steps back one period.
paymentDeleteConfirmPlain: The payment is removed from the history. The principal outstanding is recalculated and "Next due" steps back one period.
paymentEditLinkedNote: Both transactions recorded in the account are updated to match.
linkDescription: Records the loan money you received in the account you choose, so the account balance matches what really happened. Transactions you entered yourself on the Transactions page are not detected: if you already entered the money you received by hand, delete that transaction first so it is not counted twice.
linkIncludePayments: {count, plural, one {Also record the # existing payment} other {Also record the # existing payments}}
linkIncludePaymentsHelper: Each payment is recorded on its own date, principal and interest as two transactions; payments already recorded in an account are left as they are. Payments you entered yourself on the Transactions page are not detected — delete those transactions first, or untick this box, so nothing is counted twice.
linkFuturePayments: {count, plural, one {# payment is dated after today, so it is not recorded in an account; it is left as it is.} other {# payments are dated after today, so they are not recorded in an account; they are left as they are.}}
linkNoAccounts: You have no active {currency} account yet — add one first.
linkArchivedAccount: That account has just been archived. Reload the page and choose an active account.
unlinkConfirmTitle: Remove the loan with {name} from its account?
unlinkConfirmBody: The transaction that recorded the loan money you received is deleted, and the account balance moves back. Payments recorded in an account keep their transactions. The loan stays — you can then record it in the right account.
unlinkConfirmBodyWithPayments: The transaction that recorded the loan money you received and the principal and interest transactions of its {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} recorded in an account are deleted, and the account balances move back. The loan, its payments and "Next due" stay as they are — you can then record them all in the right account.
unlinkIncludePayments: {count, plural, one {Also remove the # payment recorded in an account} other {Also remove the # payments recorded in an account}}
